name: Checkmarx
description: Checkmarx One SAST/SCA application security platform

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Checkmarx One as an admin
2. Open Settings > Identity and Access Management > API Keys
3. Generate an API Key (this is a JWT refresh token)
4. Select the matching region for your Checkmarx One tenant
5. Paste the key and save. The integration exchanges it for an OAuth access token at runtime.

credentialFields.label: API Key
credentialFields.helpText: Checkmarx One > Settings > Identity and Access Management > API Keys. The tenant is auto-detected from the key.

credentialFields.label: Region
credentialFields.helpText: Select the Checkmarx One region matching your tenant URL.
